entries.en: The door is tightly sealed.
The door is locked.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sheesh, it ain't openin'. Guess we gotta[n]sign up to get in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh well. Let's head over to the counter[n]and pay our registration fee.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God damn! It's so freakin' dark!
entries.uk: Чорт забирай! Та тут же темно,[n]хоч в око стрель!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is definitely not "a little"—we've[n]been tricked.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm sensing Shadows too. "Very simple,"[n]my ass.
entries.uk: Я ще й Тіней відчуваю.[n]«Нескладний», аякже.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If we do not ascertain the layout and[n]placement of the enemies, we will[n]surely find ourselves in danger.
entries.uk: Якщо не з'ясуємо планування[n]й розташування ворогів,[n]неодмінно втрапимо в халепу.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I just hope there is an adequate way[n]of doing so...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oooh, we made it through!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is that it though? It feels like there's[n]more up ahead.
entries.uk: І це все? Таке відчуття,[n]що попереду є ще щось.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: No way... It's not opening!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Impossible. We took the only path[n]available straight to this point.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, the participants are trapped in here[n]to fall victim to the Shadows?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...It seems they have no intention[n]of letting us proceed further.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, this is cheatin'... Actually, it's[n]even worse than cheatin'!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Regardless, let's search for a way past[n]here. We can't get the coins if we don't[n]reach the goal.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Huh, it's not opening!?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Odd. That [clr 2]duct[clr 27] excluded, the path here[n]from the entrance was quite direct.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, the participants are trapped in here[n]to fall victim to the Shadows?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...It seems they have no intention of[n]letting us proceed further.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They're cheatin', dammit!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Fine. Things are different now.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We will make it to the goal, even if we[n]have to use that [clr 2]secret passage[clr 27].
